propositions: The mapping seam configuration surface requires authoritative documentation covering the reserved [tool.rebar.mapping] section with full axis catalog, merge layers, and per-project keying.

Future integrators need explicit documentation of the provider-neutral reuse contract and the split between neutral core and provider-specific adapters to support future targets like Linear/GitLab/GitHub-Issues.
The feature must be additive with a backward-compatibility guarantee: absent [tool.rebar.mapping] section reproduces current hardcoded behavior, and rollback requires only section deletion.

All mapping behavior is exercised by injected-transport unit tests with no live provider dependencies, and the probe command degrades gracefully offline, ensuring no capability is gated on specific CI providers.
